name: Siêu thực 4D Người vô diện (4D Faceless Forensic)
prompt: Hyper-realistic 4D forensic documentary reconstruction rendered in Cinema 4D Octane and Unreal Engine 5 (Fern and Lemmino investigative 3D style): all human characters are smooth, sculpted FACELESS mannequin figures (completely smooth blank heads without eyes, nose, or mouth — never realistic human faces), wearing hyper-detailed realistic fabric clothing with expressive posture and hand gestures inside photorealistic 3D/4D architectural environments with volumetric lighting, shallow depth of field (35mm f/1.8), and cinematic chiaroscuro shadows. 3-tier character material differentiation: (1) Victims / Seniors: warm matte ivory-alabaster faceless figure wearing humble everyday clothing (knitted wool cardigan, cotton shirt, holding a paper bank passbook and glowing smartphone) under warm tungsten lamp light; (2) Criminals / Syndicate Masterminds: smooth matte obsidian-charcoal or dark-slate faceless figure wearing bespoke luxury suits (with metal USB cold wallet) or crumpled dark operator shirts (in front of glowing bare smartphone motherboards) rim-lit by cold crimson/emerald screen glow; (3) Cyber Police / Financial Auditors: brushed cool silver-grey faceless figure wearing dark navy investigative jackets and police lanyards. Strictly no real human faces, no 2D cartoon/stickman, and no gibberish text.
